purpose_context: Directives carry an enforcement level and prose about how binding they are, and the two disagree (#233). How strictly a directive binds is a property of the adopting project's charter. This mission defines required, lenient-adherence and advisory once in the foundation glossary and the pack-authoring guidance, removes self-binding prose from directive bodies and the software-dev plan/implement/review content, and keeps the enforcement field as a pack-supplied default because the pinned charter schema requires it.
purpose_tldr: Define the directive enforcement levels once and take enforcement and criticality prose out of every pack's content.
